::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru semiconductor-IP company that has delivered silicon-proven SerDes and PHY IP since 2010, verified on TSMC, GlobalFoundries and Samsung processes from 65nm to 12nm. Licenses IP; does not sell chips of its own.
:::

## What does this firm design?

High-speed SerDes, PHY and analog interface IP licensed to chip companies.
